SIT-143.text:
Password ye kigambo eky’ekyama oba ennamba z’okozesa okuggulawo essimu, akawunti oba App y'essimu yo. Ekuyamba okukuuma ebintu byo obutayingirwamu bantu balala abatalina lukusa. kilinga kisumuluzo ekya digito

Okugeza, bw’oba oyagala okuyingira mu WhatsApp oba email yo, osobola okusabibwa okuwandiika password yo. Kirungi okukozesa password enzibu okuteebereza era togibuuliranga bantu balala.
SIT-143.note:
A password is a secret word, combination of letters, numbers or symbols that you use to access your phone, account or application. It helps protect your information from people who are not authorized to access it.

For example, when logging into your WhatsApp or email account, you may be asked to enter your password. It is important to use a strong password and never share it with others.

SIT-149.text:
Data bundle ye data oba yintaneeti gy'ogula ku ssimu yo okusobola okukozesa yintanet.

Okugeza, bw'oba oguze data bundle, osobola okukozesa WhatsApp, Facebook, YouTube, Google n'emikutu emirala ku yintaneeti nga tonnaba kugimalawo.

Data bundle erina obungi obw'enjawulo nga  MB oba GB, era esobola okuggwaako ng'okozesa yintaneeti ennyingi oba ng'obudde bwayo buweddeko.
SIT-149.note:
A data bundle is a package of internet data that you buy for your phone so you can access the internet.

For example, when you buy a data bundle, you can use WhatsApp, Facebook, YouTube, Google and other online services until your data runs out.

Data bundles come in different sizes, such as MB or GB, and may expire when you use up the data or when their validity period ends.
